citation: Dawson DA, Schultz TW. Equations for estimating binary mixture toxicity: Methyl-2-chloroacetoacetate-containing combinations. Toxicology Reports 2025;14:101939. doi:10.1016/j.toxrep.2025.101939

research_question.text: Characterise the toxicity of binary mixtures containing methyl-2-chloroacetoacetate (M2CA) in the Microtox assay; Table 2 reports how repeatable the 31 tests of M2CA alone were.
research_question.source_sentence: The repeatability of the M2CA tests was assessed by calculating the mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation (CV), range, and Shapiro-Wilk W values for each ECx, slope, s, r2, and TDT value.

setting.population: Bioluminescence inhibition in the marine bacterium Allovibrio fischeri (Microtox).
setting.source_sentence: The marine bacterium Allovibrio fischeri was the model organism for testing.

data_sources.name: OSF raw data deposited by the authors
data_sources.summary: For each of 30 binary combinations (M2CA = chemical A), three tests: A alone, B alone and the mixture, each with seven duplicated concentrations and % effect at 15, 30 and 45 min.
data_sources.source_sentence: Chemical A was always M2CA, while chemical B was one of the 30 chemicals noted in Table 1.

general_manipulations.description: Each test: seven concentrations in duplicate plus a duplicated control; % effect is already computed from the light readings by the instrument software.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: Each test within a given combination had seven duplicated concentrations and a duplicated control.

general_manipulations.description: Readings after 15, 30 and 45 minutes of exposure.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: Toxicity assessments were made after 15-, 30-, and 45-minutes of chemical exposure.

general_manipulations.description: The 31 tests of M2CA alone: the A-alone test of each of the 30 combinations, plus the sham combination M2CA-M2CA, where chemical B is also M2CA.
general_manipulations.source_sentence: One combination was a sham (M2CA-M2CA), giving 31 tests of M2CA alone.
general_manipulations.gap_note: Which test of the sham combination supplies the 31st M2CA-alone value is not stated (its B-alone test is M2CA tested alone).

tables.name: Table 2
tables.caption: Summary statistics for methyl-2-chloroacetoacetate (M2CA) tested alone (n = 31).

specification.description: Each test's concentration-response data (y = % effect vs concentration x, in µM) are fitted separately at each exposure time with the 5PL-1P function: the five-parameter logistic without its minimum-effect parameter. Parameters: maximum effect, EC50, Hill slope, asymmetry s.
specification.source_sentence: User-developed program files fitted the raw data to sigmoid curves using the five-parameter logistic function from which the minimum effect parameter had been removed [14].
specification.gap_note: Whether the duplicate replicates are fitted as separate points or averaged first, and the least-squares weighting, are not stated.

specification.description: Equation 1: y = max / (1 + (xb/x)^Hillslope)^s. Equation 2: xb = EC50 × 10^((1/Hillslope) × log10(2^(1/s) − 1)), so that y = max/2 at x = EC50.
specification.source_sentence: in which y = % effect, max = maximum effect, x = concentration, and s = asymmetry.
specification.gap_note: The equations are printed with garbled layout. This reading (the standard 5PL with the minimum removed, parameterised by EC50) is the extractor's reconstruction.

specification.description: Fitting constraints: EC50 > 0; 0.1 < s < 10; max fixed at 100. Initial values estimated automatically.
specification.source_sentence: The constraints used for fitting were: a) EC50 > 0, b) 0.1 < s < 10, c) max = 100.

specification.description: From each fit: EC25, EC50, EC75 (concentrations giving 25, 50 and 75 % effect on the fitted curve), slope, s, maximum effect and r2 (coefficient of determination).
specification.source_sentence: The following values were calculated for A, B and MX at each exposure duration: EC25, EC50, EC75, slope, s, maximum effect, and coefficient of determination (r2).
specification.gap_note: 'Slope' is not defined further; the Hill slope parameter of Eq. 1 is the natural reading. The r2 definition (1 − SSres/SStot over all points) is not stated.

specification.description: Time-dependent toxicity per test, from its 15- and 45-min EC50s: TDT = ((EC50_15 − EC50_45) / (EC50_15 × 0.667)) × 100.
Across the 31 M2CA-alone tests, for each quantity and time: mean, standard deviation, CV = SD/mean × 100, range, and Shapiro-Wilk W.
specification.source_sentence: The repeatability of the M2CA tests was assessed by calculating the mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation (CV), range, and Shapiro-Wilk W values for each ECx, slope, s, r2, and TDT value.
specification.gap_note: The SD denominator (n − 1 or n) is not stated, and neither is whether 'range' is max − min or the min-max interval (the table prints one number).
